info.title: Queue OpenAPI for reve/2.1/edit
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the reve/2.1/edit queue.

x-fal-metadata.about: Edit an image based on a text description using Reve Image 2.

21EditInput.description: Input for Reve Image 2 (v2) image editing

output_format.description: Output format for the generated image.
output_format.title: Output Format

aspect_ratio.description: The desired aspect ratio of the generated image. With `auto`, the model picks an appropriate aspect ratio for the request.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

image_url.description: URL of the reference image to edit. Must be publicly accessible or base64 data URI. Supports PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, and HEIF formats.
image_url.title: Reference Image URL

prompt.description: The text description of how to edit the provided image. You can refer to the reference image with `<frame>0</frame>`.
prompt.title: Prompt

sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

21EditInput.title: ReveImage2EditInput

21EditOutput.description: Output for Reve Image 2 (v2) image editing
21EditOutput.title: ReveImage2EditOutput

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.
height.title: Height

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.
width.title: Width

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
